question: Do pleasure and pain at death destroy an awakened person's liberation?
premises: An awakened person may experience varied pleasure and pain during life.
Those experiences do not destroy the liberated state.
Death is comparable to other phases of experience.
inference: Therefore the varieties of pleasure and pain at death likewise do not destroy liberation.
plain_english: So, just as the varied pleasures and pains of an awakened person during life do not destroy their liberated state, those same kinds of experiences do not destroy it at death either.
